verdict.rationale: Intercom publishes an official TypeScript/Node SDK (intercom-node) with convenient API access and iterator support, plus a documented Fin Agent API and API platform for programmatic use. However, only one official SDK language is evidenced, there's no public OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404s across all candidate paths), and no independent corroboration of SDK quality/adoption exists. Missing for 10: multi-language SDK coverage, publicly discoverable OpenAPI/schema, and third-party validation of SDK reliability.
